name: quantum-casino
description: Monorepo: apps/web (Next.js leaderboard, deployed on Vercel) + supabase/ (worker Edge Function, SQL).

scripts.web:check: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.db:status: supabase db query --remote --read-only "select (select count(*) from public.nfc_reads) as taps, (select count(*) from public.scores) as score_rows, (select count(*) from public.users) as users, (select last_run_at from public.worker_state) as worker_last_run, (select last_message from public.worker_state) as worker_message"
